name: CTMS Next.js + Laravel App Router Optimization
objective: Migrate CTMS from Client Components to App Router with HTTP-only cookie auth, Server Components for data fetching, Server Actions for forms, and parallel data fetching with React.cache
exit_criteria: All 67 pages migrated from Client Components to Server Components where applicable
HTTP-only cookie auth with refresh tokens implemented (15min access, 7day refresh)
Next.js middleware.ts protecting all role-based routes
Server Actions replacing direct Axios API calls for mutations
React.cache implemented for parallel data fetching
Error boundaries and loading states on all routes
Playwright E2E tests covering critical auth flows
VPS deployment configured with PM2 and Nginx
Zero security vulnerabilities (JWT in localStorage removed)
